name: Stormbringer: Air Flow and Storm Warning native casting-time mods (#1250, #2053)
contract: #1250: Air Flow (707548) effect1 is aura 107 SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER, MiscValue 10 (SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME), EffectBasePoints -301 + EffectDieSides 1 = -300 ms (SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue, SpellInfo.cpp:494-496), EffectSpellClassMask word0 8388608 (0x800000) matching Aeroblast's (501450) own SpellFamilyFlags word0 exactly. Effect0 is the same aura/op with EffectBasePoints -1+1=0, an inert filler slot. #2053: Storm Warning (567533) effect0 is the identical mechanism, EffectBasePoints -501+1=-500 ms, EffectSpellClassMask word0 67108864 (0x4000000) matching Storm Alert's (707044) own SpellFamilyFlags word0 exactly. Both talents are SpellFamilyName 22 (Stormbringer). SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME is applied generically by Player::ApplySpellMod (Player.cpp:10219-10327, non-CASTING_TIME/DURATION branch is basevalue*totalmul+totalflat, and the CASTING_TIME branch is (basevalue+totalflat)*totalmul) via Unit::CalcCastTime, gated only by SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellmod's classmask check -- no exemption for SpellFamilyName 22. Aeroblast's CastingTimeIndex is 19 (SpellCastTimes.dbc CastTime 2500 ms) and Storm Alert's CastingTimeIndex is 5 (SpellCastTimes.dbc CastTime 2000 ms), both confirmed today via coa-dbc-viewer against /home/fab/CoaServer/dbc_clientset. Neither talent has any module code (zero hits for 707548 or 567533 under modules/ or src/server/scripts/), and none is needed; both close as regression scenarios only.
